name: Team celebrations
description: Birthdays, work anniversaries and new-starter welcomes for the office or break room. Rotating cards with colourful initials avatars, milestone badges at 1, 5, 10, 15 and 20+ years, and a list of everyone celebrating today, this week or this month. Type the people in, or keep them in a Google Sheet. Playful confetti or an elegant dark theme.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: title
params.label: Title
params.help: The heading. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: Optional. Shown beside the title.

params.name: week_start
params.label: Weeks start on
params.help: Only used by "This week".

params.name: welcome_days
params.label: Keep welcoming new starters for (days)
params.help: A new starter stays on the screen this many days after their first day, whatever the window.

params.name: animate
params.label: Animate the background (confetti / gold glints)
params.help: Turn off on very slow players.

params.name: birthday_label
params.label: Birthday heading
params.help: Above the name on a birthday card. Empty: "Happy birthday" in the screen's language.

params.name: anniversary_label
params.label: Anniversary heading
params.help: {n} is replaced by the number of years, e.g. "{n} years with us". Empty: that line in the screen's language, with the right plural.

params.name: anniversary_one_label
params.label: Anniversary heading for one year
params.help: Used for a first anniversary, e.g. "1 year with us". Empty uses the heading above, or the built-in words.

params.name: new_hire_label
params.label: New-starter heading
params.help: Empty: "Welcome to the team" in the screen's language.

params.name: list_title
params.label: List heading
params.help: Above the list of everyone in the window. Empty: "Everyone celebrating" in the screen's language. A single - hides it.

params.name: empty_title
params.label: Text when nobody is due
params.help: Empty: "No celebrations right now" in the screen's language.

params.name: empty_text
params.label: Small print when nobody is due
params.help: Empty: a friendly line in the screen's language. A single - hides it.

params.name: next_label
params.label: Heading above the next celebration (when nobody is due)
params.help: When nobody is due, the next person within a year is shown under this. Empty: "Next up" in the screen's language. A single - hides it.

params.name: people
params.label: People data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV or Manual table with one row per person. When it has the Name column it replaces the sample people below.

params.name: type_col
params.label: Type column
params.help: Optional: Birthday, Anniversary or New hire. Without it, each row gives a birthday from Date and an anniversary or welcome from Start date.

params.name: date_col
params.label: Birthday / date column
params.help: MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD. The year of a birthday is never shown.

params.name: start_col
params.label: Start date column
params.help: YYYY-MM-DD, the person's first day. Gives anniversaries and new-starter welcomes.

params.name: sample
params.label: People (used when no data source is connected)
params.help: One person per line: Name | Type | Date | Start date | Title | Team. Dates may also be today, today+3 or today+3-5y (5 years ago).

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: Decides when "today" starts. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the built-in headings, Today/Tomorrow and the dates, e.g. en-GB or de-DE. Empty uses the screen's language.
